hero_title: My Journalist's Eye. Your Legal Expertise, Clearly Shared.
hero_body: Kandel Strategies is a Los Angeles-based legal PR and media relations firm. It delivers communications, media relations, and AI visibility tracking for attorneys. Founder and CEO Jason Kandel draws on decades of newsroom experience to secure third-party media coverage. By structuring digital footprints for accurate citation in search and AI-driven answers in ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini, he turns complex legal knowledge into verifiable expertise that helps prospective clients trust and hire your firm.
philosophy_quote: I start by listening for what an attorney knows deeply and cares about. Then I look for where that knowledge can help a reporter or someone trying to understand their legal options. The goal isn't to manufacture authority. It's to make real expertise useful, visible, and easy to verify.
services_header: Core Practice Areas: Legal PR, Media Relations & AI Visibility

services.title: Legal PR
services.description: Clear, focused messaging that turns business law and corporate litigation into jargon-free language and creates opportunities for attorneys and executives to share their expertise in the media.

services.title: Media Relations
services.description: Targeted, direct outreach to reporters and influential newsrooms to secure impactful earned coverage across top-tier media outlets and legal trade publications.

services.title: AI Visibility
services.description: Structuring your public record, published work, and media coverage so tools such as Google AI Overviews and Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude cite your expertise accurately.

how_it_works_steps.title: 1. Discovery & Audit
how_it_works_steps.description: Kandel Strategies analyzes your digital footprint and identify the key messages that make you stand out.

how_it_works_steps.title: 2. Strategic Outreach
how_it_works_steps.description: The firm connects you directly with top-tier journalists looking for your specific legal expertise.

how_it_works_steps.title: 3. Amplification
how_it_works_steps.description: Kandel Strategies structures your media coverage to help your expertise stand out in search results and AI answers.

about_text: Jason Kandel is the founder of Kandel Strategies. He is a legal PR strategist providing targeted media positioning for complex corporate litigation and high-profile legal disputes. He is a former journalist with over two decades of newsroom experience at top outlets, including at the Los Angeles Times, Thomson Reuters, NBC4 Los Angeles, and LAist/KPCC.

faqs.question: What services does Kandel Strategies provide?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies provides legal PR, media relations, and AI visibility for law firms, corporate legal departments, and executives.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies assist with legal PR?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies manages press coverage during active litigation and court proceedings. The firm drafts official statements, prepares trial attorneys for reporter interviews, and handles newsroom inquiries to protect client reputations and ensure accurate coverage during high-profile legal disputes.

faqs.question: What types of legal matters does Kandel Strategies provide media strategy for?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies provides legal PR and media relations and communications for legal disputes, including commercial litigation, intellectual property disputes, entertainment and sports matters, white-collar defense, employment suits, and regulatory investigations.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies work with clients?
faqs.answer: The agency offers flexible engagement options, including ongoing monthly retainers for firm-wide media relations and project-based support for active litigation.

faqs.question: Where is Kandel Strategies located and who do you serve?
faqs.answer: Based in Southern California, Kandel Strategies serves law firms, corporate legal departments, and attorneys across California and nationwide.

faqs.question: How can I schedule a consultation with Kandel Strategies?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a consultation by emailing jason@kandelstrategies.com.
